title: Every Blue-Eyed Person on Earth Shares One Ancestor

scenes.text: Everyone with blue eyes is related.
Originally, every human had brown eyes. Then, 6,000 to 10,000 years ago, one person was born with a mutation.
It sits in the gene next to OCA2, the gene for brown pigment, and works like a switch. It turns the brown down to blue.
University of Copenhagen researchers compared blue-eyed people from Denmark, Turkey and Jordan.
Every one carried the same switch, at exactly the same spot in their DNA. One source. One ancestor.
One person, thousands of years ago. Now every blue-eyed stranger you pass is their descendant.

description:
Every blue-eyed person shares one common ancestor, according to University of Copenhagen geneticists: a mutation that arose 6,000 to 10,000 years ago created a switch in the gene next to OCA2 that turns off brown pigment in the iris.
Blue-eyed people from Denmark, Turkey and Jordan all carried the identical switch at exactly the same spot in their DNA.
Are your eyes blue?
subject: blue eye
first_comment: One mutation, one ancestor, and every blue-eyed person today. What colour are yours?
